title: Uncloud 2022
location: De Helling · De Nijverheid · WAS. · TivoliVredenburg, Utrecht
excerpt: A year of Uncloud concerts across four Utrecht venues, from De Helling to TivoliVredenburg.
description:
In 2022 Uncloud ran as a concert series across four Utrecht venues: De Helling in May, De Nijverheid in July, WAS. in October and TivoliVredenburg in December.
At De Helling: Albert van Abbe, Novi_Sad and Giovanni Iacovella. At WAS.: Deena Abdelwahed b2b Simo Cell, Forest Drive West, Talismann and Jasmin.
> Four rooms could not be more different, and that was the point: the same platform, restated per space.
credits: A project by Uncloud, curated by Jaco Schilp and Skander Jaïbi. Photography: Paulus van Dorsten and Ines Kooli.
